covered_programmes.note: The scheduled Level 1 modules match the standalone Bachelor of Financial Technology curriculum in the August 2025 brochure.
The brochure labels tourism modules as electives but gives no choose count, and the HSP intake code does not match a current brochure title.
The brochure identifies elective module lists but omits how many modules students choose.
The January 2025 brochure defines this discontinued Digital Transformation specialism and lists no student elective choices.
No applicable Telecommunication Engineering curriculum source was found. A much older APU brochure is still indexed, but its modules and elective structure do not match the active schedule.
The brochure defines Interactive Media and Immersive Technology, Game Art, and Game Technology as separate track packages.
The April 2025 brochure identifies this as Certificate in Administrative Skills and lists no student elective choices.

known_issues.message: The July 2026 brochure lists Quantum Algorithms and Quantum Machine Learning, while the inspected Computer Science schedules list Distributed Computer Systems and Database Security. These intakes remain unresolved until a matching curriculum source is added.
